title: Manhattan’s Official Culture, Neighborhood by Neighborhood, Run Forward 20 Years (2021 → 2041)
gallery_text: Curious how Manhattan's official cultural organizations have changed since the city's DCLA list stopped updating in 2021, I sketch a model that runs that list forward 20 years (2021–2041), neighborhood by neighborhood, using DCLA data and MTA subway stations. Based on an arts nonprofits study in six U.S. metro areas, where 62% of all organizations and 55% of dance organizations survived 20 years, each organization has a 2.4% (dance, 2.9%) chance of closing x year, adjusted by its distance to the nearest station, so the map can show how much that assumed subway effect changes each neighborhood.
